title: Street Corn Pasta Salad

items: 1 Tbsp kosher salt (for the pasta water)
3 cups corn kernels (from about 4 ears, or frozen and thawed, patted dry)

steps: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the 1 Tbsp salt. Cook the rotini as the package says, until al dente. Drain and rinse under cold water until cool, then shake off as much water as you can.

Heat the dry skillet over high heat 2 min. Add the corn in one layer and cook 3–4 min without stirring, until it browns in spots. Stir and cook 2–3 min more, until charred in several places. Sprinkle with ½ tsp salt and spread on a plate to cool 5 min.
Whisk the mayo, sour cream, lime juice and chili powder in the large bowl until smooth.
Add the pasta, corn, jalapeño, scallions, cilantro and ⅓ cup cotija. Toss until evenly coated. Taste and add salt or more lime juice.
Top with the extra cotija and a sprinkle of chili powder. Serve right away, or chill until serving.
tips: Add a can of drained black beans or diced cooked chicken to make it a full meal.
The pasta soaks up dressing as it sits. If making it ahead, hold back a third of the dressing and stir it in just before serving.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days in a sealed container. Stir in 1–2 Tbsp mayo or lime juice to loosen before serving. Don't freeze.
